name: Ephemeral Light: Overture
source:
The story follows Leone, the grand oracle of the church of Heliath, after she got kidnapped by the Pirate Prince in order to find the treasure of her god. 

Ephemeral Light will receive monthly updates in a chapter by chapter manner.

[From [url=https://yancomplex.itch.io/elo]itch.io[/url]]
